cases.name: built-in worked example
stdout: (no config, so the demo: B2B SaaS, Series A, $3M ARR)
AAJ Marketing Budget Plan: B2B SaaS, Series A
Planned spend:      25% of ARR  (range 20–30%, balanced → midpoint)
Basis:              AAJ stage band 20–30% of ARR (AAJ's working range, not third-party research)
Allocation: AAJ default split (an assumption to edit, not a benchmark)
• Gartner 2026: marketing budgets averaged 7.8% of company revenue, mostly at companies above $1B revenue.
• The CMO Survey 2026: marketing expenses averaged 8.96% of company revenues (154 U.S. marketing leaders answered).
• SaaS Capital 2026: median private B2B SaaS marketing spend is 8% of ARR.
• Gartner 2026: paid media 31.4% and martech 19.4% of the average marketing budget.
• Early-stage bands read high against those averages because a startup is buying growth and learning, not maintaining share (AAJ's read).
• This plan does not check runway: the figure is not capped by cash left. Confirm the spend leaves the runway you need, and run unit-economics to confirm you can afford the implied CAC.
• The demand-gen or paid slice feeds the paid-media-budget-allocation skill for the channel split.
